  • Serve as the go-to operational owner for the LMS system, curating and maintaining a dynamic, streamlined training catalog. Continuously refine materials for relevance, effectiveness, and alignment with customer needs.
  • Embody an agile, customer-obsessed mindset, rapidly producing high-quality, iterative content elevated by feedback and data.
  • Be a key driving force behind the development, engagement, and iterations of Sales and Engineering bootcamp programs.

Qualifications

  • 3-5 years of experience driving the development of L&D initiatives in a high-growth startup or late-stage tech environment.
  • Experienced leveraging LMS systems like Docebo, e-learning platforms, intranet solutions, and instructional design tools like Articulate to deliver impactful learning experiences.
  • Exceptional collaboration and interpersonal skills, with a strong customer-centric approach to building relationships and delivering outstanding service to stakeholders.
  • Proven ability to analyse training metrics, evaluate impact, and translate findings into actionable recommendations to enhance learning solutions.
  • Demonstrated skill in translating business objectives into innovative, engaging, and practical learning solutions that drive measurable results.


Values

  • We are client first : We put our clients at the centre of everything we do, because their success is the ultimate measure of our value.
  • We work at Start-Up Speed : We move fast, stay agile and favour action because momentum is the foundation of perfection
  • We are Al forward : We help our clients build the future of Al and implement it in our own roles and workflow to amplify productivity.


Advantages of joining Turing

  • Amazing work culture (Super collaborative & supportive work environment; 5 days a week)
  • Awesome colleagues (Surround yourself with top talent from Meta, Google, LinkedIn etc. as well as people with deep startup experience)
  • Competitive compensation

title: Senior .Net Developer
description:
Job Title: Senior Software Engineer (Contractor)

Job Type: Full-time (Remote)

Pay: R$20,000.00 – R$22,000.00 per month


Position Overview

We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer contractor to join our U.S.-based team remotely. You will leverage your technical expertise to deliver high-quality code for moderately to highly complex projects.

In this role, you will work on our healthcare platform, gaining deep system knowledge and contributing to our Agile workflow via Azure DevOps . You will begin with automated testing and peer reviews , expanding into broader development tasks by months 2–3. Your role will evolve based on your strengths and our needs — all while adhering to rigorous coding and security standards .


Key Responsibilities

1. Product Design & Development

  • Collaborate with stakeholders to design software solutions aligned with technical and business objectives.
  • Write, optimize, and maintain efficient code, including enhancing existing codebases (opportunities starting around months 3–4).

2. Testing & Quality

  • Design and implement automated End-to-End (E2E) tests (e.g., using Microsoft Playwright) to ensure feature stability — with a strong focus during your first 6–9 months.

3. Peer Reviews & Post-Release Support

  • Participate in pre-release feature reviews (ongoing).
  • Conduct initial post-release bug ticket analysis (first 90 days), transitioning to broader ownership over time.

4. Agile Collaboration

  • Actively contribute to 2-week sprints and 6-week release cycles (3 sprints per release).
  • Participate in sprint planning, pull requests, releases, and daily stand-ups (3:00 PM CT).

5. Communication & Coordination

  • Collaborate effectively with technical and non-technical team members across time zones.


Qualifications

Experience

  • 5–8 years of software engineering experience, with a proven track record on complex projects.

Technical Skills

  • Proficiency in C# ASP.NET (.NET 8) for web applications and APIs.
  • Experience with .NET MAUI and Blazor Web Application (.NET 8) for mobile and web development.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Azure (Azure App Service, Azure SQL, Azure Storage).
  • Proficient with modern development tools (Visual Studio, Git, Azure DevOps).
  • Knowledge of secure coding practices and cybersecurity principles.
  • Experience with cloud platforms and Agile methodologies.

Soft Skills

  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical abilities.
  • Strong communication skills for remote collaboration.
  • Ability to work independently and within a collaborative team.

Preferred

  • Familiarity with healthcare software or Protected Health Information standards (e.g., HIPAA).
  • Experience with pull request reviews and sprint participation.


How We Work

  • Agile Workflow: 2-week sprints, 6-week release cycles, daily stand-ups at 3:00 PM CT.
  • Code Standards: Strict adherence to best practices, peer reviews, and security testing (e.g., OWASP, Detectify).
  • Tools: Azure DevOps, Visual Studio, SQL Server Management Studio, Datadog, Microsoft Playwright, and more.
  • Team Culture: Accountability, quality, and excellence in delivery.

title: DevOps Pleno
description:
Quem somos nós?

Somos um ecossistema de transformação digital que combina tecnologia e visão estratégica para escalar resultados e aumentar o valor entregue aos nossos clientes. Trabalhamos na construção de soluções inovadoras e disruptivas em mais de 300 projetos com grandes empresas nacionais de múltiplos segmentos.


Nosso propósito é impactar positivamente pessoas e negócios , exponencializando cada um para atingir seu máximo potencial. Respeitamos todas as diferenças e criamos um espaço aberto e livre para você ter autonomia, expor suas ideias, aprender com os erros, se conectar com outras pessoas e gerar mudanças ao seu redor .


Se você deseja estar em um ambiente colaborativo, desafiador e que incentiva você a sempre evoluir e ser o protagonista da sua história, aqui é o seu lugar!


Antes de avançarmos, é importante você saber que:

  • Contratação: CLT
  • Modelo de Trabalho: Remoto
  • Horário: das 9h às 12h e das 13h às 18h. A jornada é flexível conforme agendas e entregas.
  • Etapas do Processo: Composto por 3 a 4 etapas, com um tempo médio de até 03 dias úteis entre uma etapa e outra.
  • Meios de Comunicação: Utilizamos E-mail e WhatsApp. Certifique-se de que essas informações estejam corretas no momento de inscrição para evitar falhas na comunicação.


O que buscamos?

Estamos em busca de um/uma DevOps para fazer parte de nosso movimento. Quem ocupar esta posição será responsável por gerenciar o ciclo de vida completo de aplicações, desde o desenvolvimento até a entrega em produção, garantindo eficiência e agilidade por meio da automação e de metodologias ágeis.


Como será seu dia-a-dia?

  • Gerenciar e manter ambientes em cloud (AWS) , garantindo escalabilidade, segurança e eficiência.
  • Implementar e gerenciar soluções de infraestrutura como código (IaC) utilizando Terraform .
  • Desenvolver e otimizar pipelines de CI/CD em GitLab , automatizando todo o ciclo de entrega.
  • Aplicar práticas de GitOps com Argo CD , assegurando a automação e consistência das implantações.
  • Administrar e evoluir ambientes Kubernetes , monitorando performance, consumo e segurança dos clusters.
  • Criar e manter scripts de automação para tarefas rotineiras, integrações e melhorias de processos.
  • Configurar e monitorar ferramentas de observabilidade como Datadog, New Relic ou Dynatrace , garantindo visibilidade e resposta rápida a incidentes.
  • Colaborar com times de desenvolvimento e produto para garantir entregas rápidas, seguras e de alta qualidade.
  • Contribuir para a melhoria contínua dos processos e da arquitetura de infraestrutura.


Para cumprir esse desafio, você precisa dominar:

  • Conhecimento aprofundado em Kubernetes , com experiência na administração de clusters, deploys (Helm/Manifests), configuração de RBAC, network policies e troubleshooting em produção.
  • Experiência com GitOps utilizando Argo CD , incluindo implementação e manutenção de pipelines, gestão de sincronização de aplicações e rollback automatizado.
  • Experiência com GitLab , aplicando CI/CD para pipelines complexos, runners, templates e integração com ambientes cloud.
  • Conhecimento aprofundado em AWS , com vivência prática em serviços como EC2, EKS, RDS, S3, IAM, VPC, autoscaling e otimização de custos.
  • Conhecimento aprofundado em Terraform , incluindo desenvolvimento e manutenção de módulos reutilizáveis, gerenciamento de estado remoto e versionamento de infraestrutura.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de observabilidade como Datadog, New Relic ou Dynatrace, configurando métricas, alertas, dashboards e tracing.
  • Experiência com scripting e automação , utilizando Python, Bash ou Go para automação de operações, criação de pipelines e integrações.
  • Vivência prática com CI/CD , desenhando, implementando e otimizando pipelines de integração e entrega contínua, com testes automatizados e estratégias de rollout (canary, blue/green).
  • Conhecimento em práticas de segurança em cloud e containers , incluindo hardening de clusters, gestão de segredos, políticas de acesso e scanners de vulnerabilidade.


O que oferecemos aos nossos Builders?

  • Auxílio Alimentação (VA/VR) no cartão Caju;
  • Auxílio Home-Office no cartão Caju;
  • Programa de Pontos Flexíveis em seu Caju - um valor fléxivel para você usar como você quiser;
  • Plano de Saúde Nacional Porto Seguro (Plano Prata com apartamento e sem coparticipação) com 50% da mensalidade custeada pela Builders;
  • Assistência Odontológica pela Porto Seguro (Plano Bronze) com 100% da mensalidade paga pela Builders;
  • Auxílio Creche para crianças de até 72 meses;
  • Auxílio à Saúde Mental - acesso ao aplicativo Vida+;
  • Auxílio à Saúde Física - acesso ao aplicativo Gympass;
  • Seguro de vida.

title: Salesforce Data Cloud Consultant

Data Cloud Consultant

Recommendation:

Experience in implementing and working with strategy and data modeling, including building multiple solutions on Salesforce clouds.

- Have experience in development, strategy, business analysis, pre-sales solutions, or architecture.


Job Description:

Responsible for conducting customer discussions around requirements and technical drawing.

Development of software programs by technical specifications following programming standards and procedures, performing unit tests, performing program modifications and responding to problems by diagnosing and correcting logic and coding errors.

Ensure that secure coding and UI standards and best practices are applied during development.

Provide inputs and contribute to the improvement and maintenance of applications and programs.

Leading efforts to configure, analyze, design, develop, and maintain program code and applications.

Execution of detailed and complex unit tests and secure code testing and troubleshooting.

Conducting and supporting the source code management process.

Contributing to integration, systems and performance testing and code tuning.

Participation in secure code peer reviews.

Definition and promotion of opportunities for the reuse of code, configurations, procedures and techniques.


Requirements:

Degrees in computer science, computer engineering, or a related field are preferred.

Fluency in English to conduct technical meetings with offshore team, support teams and customers outside Brazil.

Experience with Data Architecture

Experience in writing SQL queries and data modeling, as well as governance and architecture performance practice and guidelines

Proficient in migrating data from traditional applications to Salesforce using the Import Wizard and Data Loader utility

Experienced in handling multi-country deployments and managing multiple instances of Salesforce.com

Experience with setting up and customizing managed Field Service packages is a plus.

Solution Modeling - Creates, designs, and formulates models, diagrams, and documentation using IT processes, standards, tools, version control, and build and test automation to meet business, technical, security, governance, and compliance requirements.

Data Modeling - Creates, writes, and tests data models, test scripts, and build scripts using IT processes, patterns, and tools, version control, and automation

Performance tuning - Conceptualizes, analyzes, and resolves application, database, and hardware issues using IT processes, standards, and tools, version control, and build and test automation to meet business, technical, security, governance, and compliance requirements.

Solution Validation Testing - Validates a configuration item or solution change using the IT Operating Model (ITOM), including SDLC standards, tools, and metrics, to ensure that it works as designed and meets customer requirements.

Customer Focus - Building strong customer relationships and providing customer-centric solutions.

Manages complexity – Understanding complex, high-quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to solve problems effectively.

Global perspective – Take a broad view when addressing issues, using a global lens.

Action-oriented – Taking on new opportunities and difficult challenges with a sense of urgency, high energy, and enthusiasm.

Optimizes work processes – Knowing the most effective and efficient processes to get things done, with a focus on continuous improvement.


Skills:

Knowledge of service-oriented design (SOA) principles.

Excellent oral, presentation and written communication skills.

Good interpersonal skills.

Extensive knowledge of Salesforce technology and specifically the data cloud and its features and terminologies;

Experience in positioning and implementing Salesforce Data Cloud.

Salesforce Data Cloud certifications will be a plus for this role.

Proven experience in implementation and consulting of Salesforce Data Cloud environments.


At HCLTech, we don’t just offer jobs — we offer journeys. Join a global team where your work drives innovation, your ideas matter, and your growth is supported every step of the way.


Why Choose HCLTech?

  • Be part of a purpose-led organization with a global footprint

  • Work on cutting-edge technologies in enterprise integration
  • Enjoy career mobility, continuous learning, and a culture of inclusion

title: Cloud Engineer with Data Platforms Experience
description:
About the Product:

For more than 30 years, Carnegie has been a leader and innovator in higher education marketing and enrollment strategy, offering groundbreaking services in the areas of Research, Strategy, Digital Marketing, Lead Generation, Slate Optimization, Student Search, Website Development, and Creative that generate authentic connections.


Job Purpose:

The Cloud Engineer with Data Platforms Experience will be responsible for building and maintaining cloud infrastructure and applications that primarily interface with data platforms, as well as building and maintaining Python-based applications that may or may not be deployed in the cloud. This role will ensure that our cloud environments and data-centric applications are built, configured, optimized, and adopted to meet evolving needs. The Cloud Engineer will own infrastructure requirements, configuration standards, performance optimization, and cross-team coordination related to cloud and data platforms.


Duties and Responsibilities:

Cloud Infrastructure and Data Platforms

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable and secure cloud infrastructure that supports data platforms.
  • Implement and manage cloud-based data platforms such as BigQuery/Redshift, GCS/S3, etc.
  • Develop and maintain infrastructure-as-code solutions using tools like Terraform/CloudFormation.
  • Implement and manage cloud-based CI/CD workflows for infrastructure and data platform deployments.
  • Monitor and optimize cloud resource performance and cost.
  • Ensure data quality checks for source, integration, and reporting layers; escalate defects with clear reproduction steps and impact.


Python Application Development

  • Design, develop, and maintain Python-based applications, both cloud-deployed and on-premises.
  • Utilize Python libraries such as Flask for application development.
  • Implement and manage CI/CD workflows for Python applications.
  • Collaborate with development teams to integrate applications with cloud and data platforms.


Collaboration and Communication

  • Serve as a primary liaison among business leads, product managers, and data/engineering teams.
  • Facilitate demos, knowledge-sharing sessions, and best-practice documentation for data solutions.
  • Promote adoption of new data capabilities and practices; gather feedback for continuous improvement.


Release and Change Management

  • Coordinate release plans, timelines, and stakeholder readiness for data model and SQL deployments.
  • Ensure training, job aids, and rollout communications are prepared and delivered for data solutions.
  • Track post-release issues, adoption, and stabilization metrics related to data platforms.


Knowledge/Skills/Abilities:

  • Ability to produce and manage, work autonomously, and take initiative.
  • “Can-do” attitude with unwavering ethics and a willingness to help others.
  • Exceptional relationship-building skills, cultural competency, and ability to communicate effectively with diverse groups of people and roles.
  • Willingness to embrace relational nuances, own personal mistakes, be empathetic, address conflicts directly and transparently, and commit to self-reflection and self-betterment.
  • Dexterity to effectively deal with ambiguity, change, and continuous process improvements.
  • Strong business analysis fundamentals: elicitation, documentation, process mapping, traceability, UAT.


Requirements:

  • Familiarity with cloud-based data platforms, e.g., BigQuery/Redshift, GCS/S3, and etc.
  • Infrastructure-as-code solutions, e.g., Terraform/CloudFormation.
  • Cloud-based CI/CD workflows.
  • Performance and cost optimization for cloud resources.
  • Experience with Python and familiarity with libraries such as Flask.
  • Experience with Git and Git providers, e.g., GitHub/BitBucket/GitLab.


Nice-to-haves:

  • Cloud-based IAM, networking, and security.
  • Experience with data orchestration frameworks, e.g., Airflow, Prefect, Dagster, dbt.
  • Experience with monitoring and observability tools.


Credentials and Experience:

  • College degree or equivalent life/work experience.
  • 5+ years in cloud engineering, data engineering, systems administration, or product operations within SaaS, marketing technology, higher ed tech, or related domains.


We offer:

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health/Sport Budget.
  • Fully remote.

Diagnosticar e resolver questões técnicas complexas relacionadas às implementações de brXM.


Desenvolvimento & Implementação:

Supervisionar a entrega técnica completa dos projetos brXM, incluindo desenvolvimento, testes e implantação.

Trabalhar em colaboração com equipes de desenvolvimento multifuncionais para garantir a execução fluida dos projetos.

Garantir que as entregas técnicas atendam a altos padrões de qualidade e sejam entregues no prazo.


Mentoria & Compartilhamento de Conhecimento:

Orientar desenvolvedores juniores sobre as melhores práticas e novas funcionalidades do Bloomreach.

Contribuir para o desenvolvimento de metodologias internas, ferramentas e melhores práticas para implementações brXM.

Manter-se atualizado com as últimas tendências e atualizações no espaço de plataformas de experiência digital (DXP) e no roadmap de produtos Bloomreach.


Requisitos Técnicos:

Mais de 5 anos de experiência com plataformas CMS ou DXP de nível empresarial, sendo pelo menos 3 anos focados especificamente no Bloomreach Experience Manager (brXM).

Experiência comprovada com os principais recursos do brXM, como o modelo Headless State (HST), Content as a Service (CaaS) e modelagem avançada de conteúdo.

Especialização na integração do brXM com sistemas terceiros, como CRMs, PIMs, plataformas de e-commerce (ex: Salesforce Commerce Cloud, SAP Hybris) e ferramentas de automação de marketing.

Experiência com ferramentas de build e gerenciamento de dependências (ex: Maven, Gradle) e sistemas de controle de versão (ex: Git).

Familiaridade com práticas e ferramentas DevOps, incluindo pipelines CI/CD, containerização (Docker, Kubernetes) e infraestrutura em nuvem (AWS, Azure, GCP).

Experiência em tuning de performance e otimização de aplicações brXM, incluindo estratégias de cache e otimização de banco de dados.

Compreensão de tecnologias de busca e sua integração com brXM, especialmente Bloomreach Search ou Apache Solr/Elasticsearch.

Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Tecnologia da Informação ou área relacionada, ou experiência prática equivalente.

title: Generative AI Engineer
description:
Location: Remote (Applications open worldwide)

Compensation: $20,000 – 40,000 / year (based on experience and scope of ownership)

Skills: Semantic Search, Vector Databases, Prompt Engineering, GenAI Frameworks, React Agents, Graph Agents, Document Parsing, Python, Scalable APIs


About AnswerThis


AnswerThis is an AI-powered research platform built to eliminate the most time-consuming part of academic research: the literature review. We serve researchers globally, from PhD students to academic professionals, helping them go from query to a comprehensive, cited review in minutes.

Our system understands how papers connect, ranks relevance, summarizes insights, and maps citations. This removes weeks of manual work. But that is just the beginning. We are building a vertically integrated AI research suite that streamlines every stage of academic discovery.

If you want to design algorithms that directly accelerate science in medicine, AI, climate, and more, this is the place to do it.


The Role


We are hiring an AI Engineer to lead the development of the core intelligence behind AnswerThis. This role requires deep expertise in information retrieval, scalable backend systems, and generative AI.

You will:

  • Build and optimize semantic search pipelines, graph-based retrieval, and agentic systems.
  • Design and deploy scalable APIs and services capable of serving hundreds of concurrent requests.
  • Architect, implement, and productionize vector databases and embedding-based retrieval systems.
  • Work on GenAI integrations including react agents, graph agents, prompt engineering, and LLM orchestration.
  • Set up full-stack search engines from scratch that can handle real-world academic workloads.
  • Contribute directly to the infrastructure that makes cutting-edge science more efficient.


This is a hands-on role with real ownership. You will move fast, experiment, and ship production systems that impact thousands of researchers worldwide.


Requirements


  • Strong background in semantic search, vector databases, LLM frameworks, agent-based systems, and document retrieval.
  • Skilled in Python for backend development with the ability to build scalable APIs and services.
  • Past experience deploying systems at scale, including search engines, retrieval pipelines, or embedding models.
  • Ability to design infrastructure that serves hundreds of concurrent requests.
  • Experience setting up and hosting APIs with public access while balancing speed, cost, and reliability.
  • A research-driven and pragmatic mindset with a focus on measurable outcomes.


Compensation


$20,000 – 40,000 / year depending on experience, expertise, and scope of ownership. This is a full-time role with significant responsibility and long-term upside.


How to Apply


Send the following to

Subject: AI Engineer Application

Include:

  • Your resume.
  • Details of past projects, especially production-level work with search, retrieval, or GenAI pipelines.
  • A short note on why you want to design algorithms at AnswerThis.


Applications without these will not be considered.

Let us build the future of research together.

description:
Job Title: Customer Success Analyst

Location: Remote

Employment Type: Contractor

Team: Customer Success


About us:

Closir is a UK-based investor relations (IR) support services provider. For over a decade we have been entrusted by blue chip companies around the world to help them achieve their IR objectives due to our intimate knowledge of the global buy-side, our technological expertise, and our close, long-term partnership approach.

The Closir platform is an all-in-one, web-based solution which makes companies much smarter and more effective, by helping them to achieve their IR objectives intelligently and proactively.

Closir combines all elements of IR, from high-level strategy (“Who’s investing in my peers?”) to daily workflow (“What topics came up most in my meetings with investors this quarter?”) into one intelligent, user-friendly platform which includes the most comprehensive and up-to-date database of buy-side contacts on the market; proactive outreach tools; share & peer holder tracking; customisable reports; and professional-level support.

We are looking for a self-driven and customer-centric individual to join our Customer Success Team. In this role, you will be responsible for attending to our clients’ needs and inquiries; get them onboarded on the Closir journey and increase their adoption of the platform in their day to dat activities. 

You will be working closely with the Research and Product Development teams to ensure seamless integration of the clients profile and portfolio of data and help them get started on Closir.com

  • Partner with clients to understand their Investor Relations needs and drive adoption of the Closir platform.

  • Deliver tailored onboarding, training, and consulting sessions.

  • Build long-lasting relationships that foster retention, growth, and client advocacy.


Qualifications:


  • Background in Investor Relations (in-house or advisory) – you understand the workflows, challenges, and priorities of IR professionals.

  • Strong communication and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate complex needs into actionable solutions.
  • Passion for SaaS, fintech, and improving how companies engage with investors.


Why Join Us?

title: Especialista de Prompts
description:
Missão do cargo

O Especialista de Prompts atua como o arquiteto das interações entre pessoas e agentes de Inteligência Artificial, sendo responsável por traduzir necessidades humanas em comandos estruturados, claros e seguros. Seu objetivo é maximizar a precisão, a eficiência e a confiabilidade das respostas geradas pelos modelos de linguagem.

Esse profissional é o ponto de conexão entre o conhecimento do negócio e as capacidades dos modelos de IA, assegurando que as soluções corporativas entreguem resultados consistentes, éticos e mensuráveis para o desempenho das áreas.


Principais responsabilidades

  • Projetar, testar e otimizar prompts para modelos de linguagem (LLMs), aplicando técnicas avançadas como few-shot prompting, chain-of-thought e role-based prompting;
  • Desenvolver frameworks e templates reutilizáveis por área de negócio, criando bibliotecas internas de prompts com versionamento e controle de qualidade;
  • Definir e acompanhar métricas de qualidade de resposta, incluindo precisão, coerência e tempo de execução, além de realizar tuning de contexto com uso de embeddings, RAG e feedback humano;
  • Garantir conformidade com políticas de segurança, confidencialidade e ética, assegurando aderência à LGPD e aos padrões de governança de IA;
  • Elaborar e manter documentação técnica, diretrizes e boas práticas de engenharia de prompts corporativos;
  • Integrar soluções de prompting com fluxos e pipelines de IA corporativa, em colaboração com cientistas de dados e engenheiros de machine learning;
  • Aplicar princípios de vibecoding para calibrar tom, estilo e empatia nas respostas dos agentes de IA, garantindo consistência com a identidade verbal da empresa;
  • Conduzir experimentos e testes A/B de prompts, utilizando metodologias de avaliação e monitoramento de performance;
  • Automatizar processos de geração, teste e avaliação de prompts por meio de Python, JSON Schema e pipelines de CI/CD;
  • Promover treinamentos e ações de evangelização interna sobre boas práticas de IA generativa;
  • Comunicar resultados e ganhos de produtividade, traduzindo dados técnicos em informações estratégicas e executivas.


Formação e experiência desejadas

  • Graduação em Engenharias, Linguística Computacional ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência de 2 a 3 anos em engenharia de prompts, processamento de linguagem natural (NLP) ou aplicações de IA generativa;
  • Inglês intermediário.


Conhecimentos técnicos

  • Plataformas e bibliotecas: LangChain, Tess, PromptLayer, LlamaIndex, HuggingFace Transformers, OpenAI API, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini API;
  • Linguagens e ferramentas: Python, JSON Schema, Regex, Git, VS Code, Notion e Jupyter;
  • Técnicas de otimização: Few-shot prompting, chain-of-thought, function calling, embeddings e RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation);
  • Métricas e testes: BLEU, ROUGE, factual consistency, toxicity filters, RLHF e testes A/B;
  • Governança e conformidade: versionamento, anonimização de dados, logs auditáveis, filtros de segurança e aderência à LGPD.


Perfil profissional

Buscamos um(a) profissional com perfil analítico e criativo, forte capacidade de comunicação escrita e abstração semântica, aliado a pensamento técnico e visão de negócio.

É essencial ter curiosidade, atenção a detalhes e compromisso com o uso ético e responsável da Inteligência Artificial no ambiente corporativo.


Venha fazer parte de uma equipe que está moldando o futuro das interações entre pessoas e Inteligência Artificial.

title: Senior HRBP LATAM
description:
We're conducting a search for a Strategic Regional Talent Partner with 10+ years of progressive HR experience, an essential and proven focus on the Latin American (LATAM) region, and fluency in Portuguese and English with good verbal communication in Spanish.

This role works very closely with the C level (VP and Director level), influencing the business and translating business objectives into effective people and talent strategies. Will drive and implement global HR initiatives across key Latin American markets and addressing the unique challenges of the region.

This is a strategic and consultancy-focused role, dedicated to high-level partnering.


Key Areas of Accountability & Impact


The Strategic Regional Talent Partner is expected to drive results across three primary domains:


1. Strategic Business Partnership & Consulting


  • Executive Guidance: Serve as the primary HR advisor to senior regional executives, translating complex business objectives into actionable people plans
  • Performance Optimization: Provide expert counsel on maximizing business unit performance
  • Global Integration: Act as the regional conduit, collaborating with global Centers of Expertise (CoE) to ensure global people initiatives are effectively localized and deployed across LATAM markets.


2. Talent Management & Program Execution


  • High-Level Program Support: Directly advise and support senior leaders during critical annual organizational cycles
  • Capability Building: Partner with business leaders to identify and close critical skill gaps
  • Stakeholder Alignment: Facilitate the integration of talent programs across the business streams, working with cross-functional HR teams


3. Operational Excellence & Continuous Improvement


  • Process Enhancement: Champion a continuous improvement mindset, actively soliciting feedback from the leadership population to refine HR processes and knowledge resources.
  • Service Model Efficiency: Effectively triage executive requests, leveraging a deep knowledge of the shared services model
  • Knowledge Leadership: Contribute to the overall organizational knowledge base and foster active knowledge sharing across the global HR community.


Required Experience, Skills, & Qualifications


Experience & Educational Foundation

  • Experience: 10+ years of progressive HR experience, with a minimum of 4+ years in a senior HR Business Partnering or strategic advisory role spanning multiple LATAM countries .
  • Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Human Resources, Business, or a related field is highly desired.
  • Context: Proven ability to operate successfully within a complex, matrixed global organization utilizing an HR shared services delivery model.

Critical Competencies

  • Business Acumen: Possesses robust business knowledge (industry trends, competitors, market position)
  • Executive Influence: Exceptional ability to build trust, influence senior leaders (VP/Director), .
  • Bilingual Capability: Fluent English is mandatory. Proficiency in Spanish and/or Portuguese is highly desirable.
  • Agility & Judgment: Demonstrates high levels of resilience, adaptability, and critical thinking to navigate ambiguity, manage high-pressure situations, and exercise sound judgment.
  • Technical Familiarity: Experience with leading HRIS platforms (e.g., Workday ) and service management tools (e.g., ServiceNow ) is preferred.

Other Requirements

  • Flexibility: Willingness to accommodate business needs across different time zones (LATAM and North America).

Análise de mercado e Bench com identificação de tendências de aplicativos e canais digitais.

Escrever histórias de usuário bem definidas e critérios de aceitação claros.

Conduzir refinamentos, plannings, reviews e retrospectivas seguindo metodologias ágeis.

Validar hipóteses e funcionalidades junto aos usuários, buscando melhorias contínuas.

Gerenciar os stakeholders e garantir a comunicação (estratégias e ações).



Buscamos alguém que apresente:

Necessário graduação completa.

Necessário domínio do Pacote Office.

Necessário conhecimento em ferramentas de apoio a gestão de projetos e produtos.

Necessário conhecimento em Scrum e frameworks ágeis.

Experiência prévia como Product Owner ou posição similar, com atuação em produtos digitais.

Vivência em desenvolvimento de aplicativos móveis (iOS e Android).

Habilidade em análise de métricas de produto (Firebase, App Store Connect, Google Play Console).

Boa comunicação e capacidade de articular diferentes áreas e stakeholders.

Procuramos alguém com experiência avançada em aplicativos digitais , que seja articulada, saiba se posicionar com clareza e tenha facilidade em conduzir conversas estratégicas com diferentes públicos.

Essa pessoa será responsável por gerenciar e priorizar o backlog da squad , garantindo alinhamento com os objetivos estratégicos da área. Também terá atuação próxima do time digital localizado em São Paulo , influenciando e direcionando prioridades de forma indireta e estruturada.

Buscamos alguém com conhecimento aprofundado sobre as lojas da Apple e Google , incluindo políticas, publicações e boas práticas de atualização de aplicativos.

Principais atividades:

  • Gerenciar e priorizar o backlog da squad, garantindo clareza e alinhamento estratégico.

  • Trabalhar em parceria com áreas de negócio, UX/UI e desenvolvimento para definir soluções funcionais e inovadoras.

Somos uma consultoria especializada em recrutamento e seleção para o ecossistema de startups e empresas de tecnologia. Atualmente, atendemos mais de 50 clientes, que vão desde early-stage, empresas seed-invested e startups Series A/B/C/D até grandes multinacionais.


Principais responsabilidades

  • Gerenciar de 8 a 12 processos seletivos simultâneos nas áreas de tecnologia, produto e negócios. Grande parte das vagas em nível executivo.
  • Conduzir o recrutamento end-to-end.
  • Alinhamento de perfil diretamente com o cliente final e área de pessoas de nossos clientes.
  • Sourcing ativo (LinkedIn Recruiter, job boards, networking)
  • Triagem de currículos e entrevistas técnicas e comportamentais
  • Apresentação de shortlist e negociação de oferta
  • Acompanhamento de onboarding
  • Ser ponto único de contato para stakeholders (tech leads, PMs, diretores e founders), garantindo clareza de expectativas


Requisitos

  • Formação: Nos importamos mais com experiência prática do que formação superior.
  • Experiência: Sólida em executive/tech search, conduzindo de 8 a 12 vagas simultâneas de nível sênior e gerencial, com foco na qualidade da entrega e evitando ser “impressora de currículos”. Foco em recrutamento estratégico e com entrega rápida/efetiva. Nosso SLA de entrega são 5 dias úteis, e nossa taxa de fechamento é entre 3 - 6 indicados.


Perfil

  • Altamente organizado e orientado a resultados
  • Excelente comunicação interpessoal
  • Capacidade de gerenciar múltiplas prioridades em ritmo acelerado
  • Resiliência à pressão e postura hands-on
  • Curioso: Nosso perfil é pesquisar sobre vagas, criar estratégias de hunting ground, conseguir ter base para entrevistar candidatos de forma qualificada.
  • Somos uma empresa jovem, com cultura dinâmica, rápida, e anti-burocrática. Se você se identifica com essa linha, será bem-vindo.


Infraestrutura

  • Computador próprio e conexão de internet estável


O que não se alinha com o nosso jeito de trabalhar

  • Dificuldade em lidar com ritmo intenso e alta pressão: Nosso dia a dia é acelerado e está em constante transformação. Quem precisa de supervisão constante, tem dificuldade com pressão ou busca um ambiente previsível pode não se adaptar bem aqui.
  • Ausência de senso de responsabilidade e rejeição à autonomia: Esperamos postura de dono: tomar decisões, assumir riscos e gerar resultados. Quem depende de orientação constante ou busca validação o tempo todo provavelmente não terá espaço. Aqui, o protagonismo é essencial e valorizado com participação nos resultados.
  • Resistência a feedbacks francos e cultura de transparência: Prezamos pela clareza e sinceridade. Feedbacks são recorrentes e parte do nosso desenvolvimento. Isso exige maturidade para aceitar críticas construtivas com abertura e humildade.
  • Apego a horários fixos: Somos uma consultoria em expansão acelerada. Problemas surgem a qualquer momento, e as soluções também. Valorizamos quem entrega com excelência mesmo que isso demande flexibilidade de agenda.


Pacote de remuneração

  • Salário Fixo PJ
  • Variável mensal: potencial médio de R$ 3.000 – 8.000 (com atingimento de meta mensal, é esperado R$4.500 - 6.000), sem teto.

title: Regulatory Affairs Manager
description:
Manager Regulatory Affairs – Global Labeling Product Leader

Location: Brazil (Remote)

Type: Full Time | 12 Month Fixed Term Contract (FTC)

Start Date: ASAP


About the Company:


Our client is a global healthcare leader specializing in innovative pharmaceutical and medical products that improve patient outcomes worldwide. With a strong focus on quality, safety, and compliance, the company operates across multiple therapeutic areas and global markets. The successful candidate will join a collaborative Regulatory Affairs organization driving excellence in labeling compliance and product lifecycle management.


Position Summary:


The Manager Global Labeling Product Leader is responsible for the development maintenance and quality oversight of primary and derived product labeling documents across global markets. This position ensures that labeling content is compliant with international regulations and internal quality standards while contributing to global labeling strategy and product lifecycle management.

You will act as a key liaison between cross functional teams including Regulatory Affairs Safety Medical and Commercial to deliver consistent compliant and scientifically accurate product information.


Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the creation revision and maintenance of primary and derived labeling documents (for example CCDS USPI SmPC) ensuring alignment with regulatory requirements and company strategy.
  • Collaborate cross functionally with Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) through Labeling Working Groups (LWG) and Labeling Committees (LC) to gain consensus on labeling content.
  • Develop labeling text supported by clinical preclinical and safety data considering competitor and market context.
  • Ensure the accuracy clarity and scientific integrity of labeling documents through effective data review and documentation traceability.
  • Support the implementation of global labeling strategies including the development of target labeling for new and existing products.
  • Partner with Global Regulatory Affairs (GRA) and Global Labeling Operations (GLO) to ensure dissemination and alignment of labeling deliverables.
  • Maintain up to date understanding of global labeling regulations (EU US and international) CIOMS guidance and industry best practices.
  • Support audits inspections and Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) management related to labeling activities.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives to optimize labeling processes and documentation quality.
  • Provide labeling support and guidance to regional and local operating companies ensuring compliance across markets.


Qualifications and Experience


Essential:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Life Sciences Pharmacy or a related discipline .
  • Minimum 4 years of experience in the pharmaceutical or healthcare industry with at least 3 years in Regulatory Affairs and product labeling.
  • Proven understanding of global labeling regulations (FDA EMA CIOMS) and regulatory documentation standards.
  • Demonstrated ability to interpret clinical and technical data and translate findings into compliant labeling text.
  • Strong skills in scientific writing data interpretation and document management systems (DMS) .
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to work in a matrixed cross functional environment .
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Word with working knowledge of Excel and PowerPoint .


Desirable:

  • Advanced degree (MS PhD MD or PharmD) in a life sciences discipline.
  • Experience leading projects or small teams in a global regulatory or labeling capacity.
  • Previous participation in process improvement or compliance initiatives .
  • Experience with labeling systems and tools supporting compliance and document traceability.


Key Competencies

  • Strong scientific and analytical thinking.
  • Excellent attention to detail and quality orientation.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities effectively.
  • Clear and professional communication with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Proactive problem solving and decision making mindset.
  • Collaborative customer focused and continuous improvement driven approach.

Pronto para a primeira fase? Estamos à sua espera!

Os dados pessoais recolhidos pela AUBAY PORTUGAL, na qualidade de Responsável pelo Tratamento, relativos à identificação, contacto e competências profissionais dos candidatos neste processo, serão tratados para efeitos de análise da candidatura, considerando que o tratamento é efetuado com base na execução de diligências pré-contratuais a pedido do titular dos dados.

Os dados pessoais enviados através da presente candidatura serão conservados pela Aubay durante todo o procedimento de recrutamento e permanecerão armazenados enquanto atualizados (por um período de dois anos).

Os dados recolhidos poderão ser transferidos ou estar sujeitos a outras operações de tratamento, desde que o titular dos dados seja informado, no âmbito de um processo padrão de candidatura e seleção, e para o cumprimento de obrigações legais durante o período exigido por lei.

Para quaisquer questões ou pedidos relacionados com os direitos de proteção de dados pessoais, o titular dos dados poderá contactar a sede da AUBAY PORTUGAL, na Avenida Duque D’Ávila, nº 46, em Lisboa, ou através do e-mail do Encarregado de Proteção de Dados (DPO) –

O titular dos dados tem igualmente o direito de apresentar reclamação junto da Comissão Nacional de Proteção de Dados (CNPD) –

We’re searching for someone with strong gameplay instincts, creative systems thinking, and a passion for designing mechanics that are strategic, rewarding, and authentic. In This Role You Will:

  • Write and maintain clear design documentation (GDDs, feature briefs, tuning sheets).
  • Collaborate closely with developers, artists, and production to prototype and refine mechanics.
  • Participate in playtests and iterate based on player feedback.
  • Contribute ideas across mission design, economy systems, and player experience.
  • Help define design processes and best practices as part of a growing studio.

  • 3+ years of professional experience in game design.
  • Proven experience with gameplay systems, progression, or balancing.
  • Strong analytical thinking and ability to translate creative ideas into testable mechanics.
  • Proficiency with Excel/Sheets for tuning and balancing.
  • Knowledge of Unity editor & autonomy to use the scriptable objects
  • Clear, structured writing and documentation skills.
  • Can think and work creatively while taking the initiative to solve problems. 
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate cross-discipline. 
  • Self-motivated, strong work ethic, and able to work independently. 
  • Drive towards professional growth.

  • Knowledge of C# in the Unity Engine.
  • Knowledge of AI behavior, or mission scripting.
  • Understanding of Unity implementation or prototyping workflows.

What We Offer:

title: Masters / PHD In Physics
description:
Innodata (NASDAQ: INOD) is a leading data engineering company. With more than 2,000 customers and operations in 13 cities around the world, we are an AI technology solutions provider of choice for 4 out of 5 of the world’s biggest technology companies, as well as leading companies across financial services, insurance, technology, law, and medicine.

By combining advanced machine learning and artificial intelligence (ML/AI) technologies, a global workforce of subject matter experts, and a high-security infrastructure, we’re helping usher in the promise of AI. Innodata offers a powerful combination of both digital data solutions and easy-to-use, high-quality platforms.

Our global workforce includes over 5,000 employees in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, the Philippines, India, Sri Lanka, Israel and Germany. We’re poised for a period of explosive growth over the next few years.


About the Role:


At Innodata, we’re working with the world’s largest technology companies on the next generation of generative AI and large language models (LLMs). We’re looking for smart, savvy, and curious subject matter experts.


We are seeking a Masters / PHD In Physics with exceptional writing and analytical skills to join our AI/ML data team. In this role, you will help train advanced Large Language Models (LLMs) by producing, curating, and reviewing high-quality educational and technical mathematics content. Your expertise will directly shape the way AI systems understand, explain, and reason about fundamental and advanced mathematical concepts.


Key Responsibilities:


Create high-quality, accurate, and pedagogically sound content in mathematics, including:

  • Conceptual explanations
  • Problem sets and solutions
  • Theoretical summaries and derivations
  • Research abstracts and technical writing


Collaborate with AI researchers and engineers to:


  • Review and refine mathematics-related model outputs
  • Identify and fill conceptual gaps in LLM training data
  • Build datasets across various mathematics domains (e.g., Algebra, Calculus, Geometry, Linear Algebra, Probability, Statistics, Number Theory, Discrete Math, etc.)
  • Provide feedback to improve LLM performance in reasoning, solving, and communicating mathematical content


Eligibility Criteria:

  • Master's or PhD in Mathematics or a closely related discipline (MS with exceptional experience may be considered)
  • Strong background in theoretical and/or applied mathematics
  • Excellent technical and academic writing skills


As part of the project, you are required to complete the English language assessment.

*The assessment is mandatory & non-billable*

At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


We are looking for a Supply Chain Analyst to join our team and help drive our growth. As a Supply Chain Analyst, you will play a critical and active role in the day-to-day operations. This is an excellent opportunity to be one of the key members of our team and position yourself for unique career growth opportunities.


Key responsibilities:


- Determine supply needs for products and services and research potential suppliers.

- Act as a link and communicate pricing and performance needs to vendors and suppliers.

- Participate in negotiations of favorable procurement contracts and prices with selected vendors and suppliers.

- Select the most suitable suppliers in terms of reliability, product quality, and cost-efficiency.

- Maintain and update a list of suppliers and their qualifications, delivery times, and potential future development.

- Prepare cost-benefit analysis reports for review by managers.


Requirements:


- 2+ years of experience in a supply management role or related position.

- Knowledge of SAP or SAP B1.

- Degree in supply chain management, logistics, business management, or related fields.

- Experience in managing inventory.

- Proficiency in SQL analysis tools and mathematical analysis.

- Interpersonal skills and ability to build and improve trust.

- Advanced level of English.


Benefits:

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Application Support Engineer – Salesforce & Azure (Specright / PDMS / Interius)
description:
We are seeking an Application Support Engineer to provide end-to-end technical and functional support for two enterprise platforms — Specright / PDMS (Salesforce-based) and Interius (Azure-hosted). This role will be responsible for ensuring smooth daily operations, resolving incidents, maintaining data integrity, and supporting integration enhancements across both systems.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Provide Tier 2/3 application support for the Specright PDMS and Interius platforms, managing incidents, service requests, and troubleshooting data and access issues.
  • Maintain and improve integrations between Salesforce-based and Azure-hosted systems; collaborate with middleware teams to configure, test, and monitor API and data connections.
  • Develop, modify, and troubleshoot Salesforce Data Loader scripts for bulk data imports, updates, and migrations.
  • Support supplier onboarding, user administration, and role-based access configuration.
  • Collaborate with business and IT teams to analyze issues, validate solutions, and optimize workflows.
  • Participate in integration testing, documentation of technical specifications, and maintenance of operational playbooks.
  • Liaise with vendor support teams (Salesforce, Specright) for escalated issues and platform enhancements.
  • Monitor system performance, identify improvement opportunities, and contribute to continuous process and system optimization.

Required Skills & Experience:

  • 5+ years of experience in enterprise SaaS application support (Salesforce preferred).
  • Hands-on experience with APIs (REST/SOAP) , authentication (OAuth/SSO), and data integration .
  • Experience with Salesforce Data Loader or similar ETL tools.
  • Exposure to Microsoft Azure environments and integration workflows.
  • Strong troubleshooting, documentation, and communication skills; able to work independently in a global environment.
  • Experience supporting packaging, supplier, or product data management systems is a plus.

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
description:
For many of us, there’s that one podcast we never miss, and video content is part of our daily routine, whether it’s professional or personal. But how many of us truly understand the effort that goes on behind the scenes? Here at Riverside, we know it well. That’s exactly why we built an AI-powered platform that helps content creators, podcasters, marketeers, and more at major brands like Netflix, Disney, Google, and Microsoft to create high-quality content with ease.

Riverside’s technology streamlines the entire content creation process, turning ideas into professional-grade content with the highest production standards, without requiring expensive equipment or external services. The secret? AI-driven tools that replace traditional production roles like editing, directing, and design, automating the entire process at the click of a button.


About the Engineering Team

We’re a team of smart, curious engineers building scalable, reliable systems that power content creation for millions. We work with modern web technologies, tackle real-world challenges in distributed systems, and keep things practical-no over-engineering, just solid solutions. If you love solving tough problems, moving fast, and building tech that creators actually use, you’ll fit right in.


On your day to day

We’re looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer (Remote) who’s passionate about technology, performance, and crafting amazing user experiences. You’ll join a global, distributed team working on the core of our platform - where most of the content of our users is being created, where stability and performance are key.


Tech Stack: TypeScript • React • Redux • Nest.js • Node.js • MongoDB • AWS


What You’ll Do:

  • Build and ship end-to-end features that power our recording & live-call experience
  • Design and maintain scalable microservices
  • Prototype quickly, iterate fast, and deliver impact
  • Collaborate with product, design & growth teams to improve UX
  • Use data to guide decisions and enhance performance

Why You’ll Love It

  • Work with a passionate, remote-first team
  • Shape the product used by thousands of creators
  • Competitive pay + flexibility + autonomy

If you love building seamless, high-performance web experiences - we’d love to meet you.


What Will Make You Stand Out?

  • Degree in Computer Science or equivalent real-world experience
  • 8+ years of software development experience
  • Deep expertise in React and JavaScript/TypeScript , applying modern best practices, design patterns, and clean code principles
  • Good experience with Node.js, MongoDB, and RESTful APIs
  • Proven experience working in remote and distributed teams
  • Excellent communication and teamwork in English
  • Bonus: Experience with Websockets, WebRTC, MediaStream, and browser APIs for audio/video

Bottom line? If you wanna take part in transforming how people and businesses share their stories globally, Riverside’s your place. The work is challenging, the culture is fast-paced, and the people are exceptionally brilliant. And if that’s not enough, we guarantee that your ideas will genuinely make an impact.

title: DevOps Engineer - AWS
description:

Location: Remote (Must be based in Brazil)

Job Type: Full-Time, Permanent

Salary: $4000-6,000 per month (Depending on experience)


IF APPLYING, SEND CV IN ENGLISH

We are seeking an experienced and motivated DevOps Engineer with strong expertise in Amazon Web Services (AWS) and a solid background in Windows-based infrastructure .

As a member of our global DevOps and infrastructure team, you will be involved in designing, building, and maintaining modern cloud platforms and automation pipelines that support our mission-critical systems.

  • Support and manage Windows-based systems including Active Directory , domain configuration , and Entra ID .
  • Implement security controls, tools, and processes aligned with best practices in cloud and infrastructure security .
  • Provide support across Windows systems as required (Linux knowledge is a plus).
  • Manage and scale containerized applications using Kubernetes .

title: Full Stack Engineer, Brazil

Optibus is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. title: Data Architect
description:

Nice-to-haves:

  • Experience in the higher education space.
  • Experience with data orchestration frameworks, e.g., Airflow, Prefect, Dagster, dbt.

  • Familiarity with Python for data scripting and automation.


Credentials and Experience:

  • College degree or equivalent life/work experience.
  • 5+ years in SQL engineering, data modelling, data engineering, or a related data-centric role, preferably within SaaS, marketing technology, higher ed tech, or related domains.


We offer:

  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule.

title: Especialista de Arquiteto de Soluções
description:
Quais são os desafios da área e do cargo:

Colaborar com outras áreas: Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com outras equipes, como desenvolvimento de software, infraestrutura e segurança da informação, para garantir entrega eficiente da solução.

title: AI Full-Stack Engineer
description:
About the Product:

For more than 30 years, Carnegie has been a leader and innovator in higher education marketing and enrollment strategy, offering groundbreaking services in the areas of Research, Strategy, Digital Marketing, Lead Generation, Slate Optimization, Student Search, Website Development, and Creative that generate authentic connections.


Job Purpose:

The AI Full-Stack Engineer will be responsible for building and maintaining AI applications on top of existing LLM APIs. This role will focus on integration, building robust AI-driven applications, and optimizing their evaluation and performance. The AI Full-Stack Engineer will ensure that our AI applications are developed, configured, and adopted to meet evolving needs, with a strong emphasis on Python-based solutions.


Duties and Responsibilities:

AI Application Development and Integration

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable and secure AI applications leveraging existing LLM APIs.
  • Implement and manage integrations with various AI platforms and services.
  • Develop and maintain Python-based applications, both cloud-deployed and on-premises, specifically tailored for AI functionalities.
  • Implement and manage CI/CD workflows for AI applications.
  • Monitor and optimize AI application performance and cost, including model evaluation and optimization.
  • Ensure data quality checks for AI models and applications; escalate defects with clear reproduction steps and impact.


Python Application Development

  • Utilize Python libraries and frameworks relevant to AI application development.
  • Collaborate with development teams to integrate AI applications with existing systems.


Collaboration and Communication

  • Serve as a primary conduit among business leads, product managers, and AI/engineering teams.
  • Facilitate demos, knowledge-sharing sessions, and best-practice documentation for AI development.
  • Promote adoption of new AI capabilities and practices; gather feedback for continuous improvement.


Release and Change Management

  • Coordinate release plans, timelines, and stakeholder readiness for AI application deployments.
  • Ensure training, job aids, and rollout communications are prepared and delivered for new AI features.
  • Track post-release issues, adoption, and stabilization metrics for AI applications.


Knowledge/Skills/Abilities:

  • Ability to produce and manage, work autonomously, and take initiative.
  • “Can-do” attitude with unwavering ethics and a willingness to help others.
  • Exceptional relationship-building skills, cultural competency, and ability to communicate effectively with diverse groups of people and roles.
  • Willingness to embrace relational nuances, own personal mistakes, be empathetic, address conflicts directly and transparently, and commit to self-reflection and self-betterment.
  • Dexterity to effectively deal with ambiguity, change, and continuous process improvements.
  • Strong business analysis fundamentals: elicitation, documentation, process mapping, traceability, UAT.


Requirements:

  • Familiarity with existing LLM APIs and experience building applications on top of them.
  • Experience with integration of AI applications into existing systems.
  • Proficiency in Python and familiarity with AI-specific libraries and frameworks.
  • Experience with optimizing AI model evaluation and performance.
  • Cloud-based CI/CD workflows.
  • Experience with Git and Git providers, e.g., GitHub/BitBucket/GitLab.


Nice-to-haves:

  • Cloud-based IAM, networking, and security.
  • Experience with data orchestration frameworks, e.g., Airflow, Prefect, Dagster, dbt.
  • Experience with monitoring and observability tools for AI applications.


Credentials and Experience:

  • College degree or equivalent life/work experience.
  • 2+ years in AI engineering, full-stack development with an AI focus, or related domains within SaaS, marketing technology, higher ed tech, or similar.
  • 6+ year in application development overall


We offer:

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health/Sport Budget.
  • Fully remote.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Job Title: Senior Full Stack Engineer

Reports to: Director of Engineering


Position Overview

The Senior Full Stack Engineer will play a key role in designing, developing, and maintaining our company’s core business applications. We’re seeking a true systems analyst who thrives on solving complex business challenges and translating them into robust, scalable, and high-performing technical solutions. This individual should be equally comfortable working on both the front-end (React) and back-end (PHP, PostgreSQL, SQL) of modern web applications and collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality software.


Strong English communication skills are essential for this role, as you’ll be working closely with internal stakeholders, product owners, and developers across global teams. You should be able to clearly articulate technical concepts, document your work effectively, and participate in discussions and code reviews with confidence.


What You Will Do

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. The individual in this position will be expected, on a regular basis, to:

  • Design, develop, and maintain back-end functionality for enterprise-level business applications using PHP and PostgreSQL .
  • Build and enhance interactive, responsive front-end interfaces using React and modern JavaScript frameworks.
  • Collaborate with other engineers, product managers, and stakeholders to enhance our company’s product line and ensure optimal system performance.
  • Write clean, well-structured, and well-tested code following best practices and coding standards.
  • Troubleshoot, debug, and optimize applications for speed, scalability, and reliability.
  • Participate in architectural discussions and help define technical direction for new features and system improvements.
  • Stay up to date with the latest trends and technologies in full stack development, contributing ideas for process and tool improvements.
  • Mentor, guide, and provide technical support to junior developers and team members.
  • Communicate effectively with non-technical teams and management to explain technical solutions in a clear, professional manner.
  • Prepare and maintain detailed technical documentation to ensure knowledge sharing and long-term maintainability of code.


What You Will Bring

  • Proven ability to write clean, well-documented, and well-tested code (samples may be requested).
  • Strong understanding of PHP , PostgreSQL , and SQL , with hands-on experience in designing, optimizing, and maintaining relational databases.
  • Proficiency with React or other modern front-end frameworks for building scalable, interactive web interfaces.
  • Experience with object-oriented programming (OOP) principles and design patterns.
  • Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and debugging skills with a proactive and solution-oriented mindset.
  • Strong attention to detail and a passion for delivering high-quality, reliable software.
  • Excellent verbal and written English communication skills , with the ability to explain complex ideas clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Strong interpersonal and collaboration skills, with experience working in agile, team-based environments .
  • Experience in the logistics, supply chain, or transportation industry is a plus.
  • Enjoys documenting code and processes, sharing knowledge, and continuously improving both personal and team skills.
  • Comfortable working in a remote, fast-paced, and globally distributed environment .


Minimum Qualifications

  • 10+ years of experience in full stack development, including both back-end and front-end technologies.
  • Hands-on experience with PHP, PostgreSQL, SQL, and React in production environments.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead complex projects from conception to deployment.
  • Strong understanding of software development life cycle (SDLC) principles and agile methodologies .
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience).

title: Senior Software Engineer (Golang)
description:
Senior Software Engineer (Golang)

Location: Remote (Brazil)

Experience: 8+ years overall

Engagement: Contractor

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Senior Software Engineer with strong expertise in Golang , Node.js , and React to develop and enhance high-performance, scalable backend services. The role emphasizes Go, gRPC, Kafka, Kubernetes, and cloud-native development across AWS and GCP . You will be responsible for building robust backend services, integrating with MongoDB , streaming data via Kafka , and ensuring reliability in containerized environments.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, implement, and maintain data-intensive Go and Node.js gRPC APIs.
  • Build, containerize, and deploy scalable Go microservices on Kubernetes (EKS, GKE).
  • Refactor and modernize legacy Node.js services into idiomatic Go for improved performance and stability.
  • Integrate and operate Apache Kafka pipelines for high-throughput event streaming.
  • Leverage AWS and GCP cloud services to build resilient, cost-effective solutions.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues promptly.
  • Conduct code reviews , mentor junior engineers, and promote best practices in testing, CI/CD, and security.
  • Participate in architectural design reviews , focusing on scalability, fault tolerance, and cost optimization.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams including Product, Program Management, and QA.
  • Provide realistic level of effort (LOE) estimates during planning cycles.
  • Prototype and experiment with emerging technologies to improve engineering velocity.

Required Skills & Experience

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience.
  • 3+ years of experience building production-grade, highly scalable Go services.
  • Expertise in writing high-performance gRPC and REST clients/servers, including protobuf contracts.
  • Hands-on experience with Kafka (stream processing, topic management, schema registry, ACLs, consumers, offsets).
  • 3+ years of experience with AWS (S3, CloudFront, EKS, etc.).
  • 1+ year of experience with GCP (Cloud Storage, Kafka, GKE, CDN, etc.).
  • 2+ years of experience designing and using MongoDB .

Nice to Have

  • 2+ years developing full-stack applications using Node.js , MongoDB , Express , and React .
  • 3+ years of experience with EKS/GKE , Helm , Terraform , and CI/CD pipelines .
  • 1+ year of Linux bash scripting for automation and ops tasks.
  • Exposure to Redis , Docker , Git , and observability stacks (Prometheus , Grafana , OpenTelemetry ).
  • Strong problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills in a globally distributed team.
  • Experience with MongoDB schemas , indexing, and sharding strategies.
  • Knowledge of ETL pipelines and CRUD operations .

title: Console Porting Developer (Unreal Engine 5 | PS5 + Xbox Series X|S)
description:
Astral Clocktower Studios is seeking an experienced Console Porting Developer strongly familiar with Unreal Engine to help bring our upcoming dark fantasy ARPG, Kristala, to PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S.


You’ll work closely with our internal engineering and QA teams to optimize performance, integrate platform services (trophies, achievements, profiles, saves), and ensure both builds meet full certification compliance on schedule.


Responsibilities:

  • Build and maintain PS5 and Xbox Series X|S versions of Kristala using Unreal Engine 5
  • Implement and test platform-specific services and UI
  • Manage performance, packaging, and certification-readiness builds
  • Collaborate with our existing dev and QA team to fix bugs and meet TRC/XR requirements
  • Assist with submission and partner portal processes (Sony + Microsoft)


Requirements:

  • Solid Unreal Engine 4/5 development experience (C++ and Blueprint familiarity).
  • At least one shipped console project on PS and XB
  • Strong understanding of PS5 and/or Xbox X|S SDKs
  • Experience with Razor/PIX Profiling Tools
  • Familiarity with certification processes and common TRC/XR pitfalls
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to collaborate with a distributed team
  • Self-sufficient problem solver with a detail-oriented mindset


Bonus Points:

  • Experience with both platforms (PS + Xbox)
  • Prior work on Soulslike or action RPG titles
  • Passion for animals, metal music, and dark fantasy worlds


Why Join Us?

Astral Clocktower Studios is a global, diverse team that has worked together for several years to bring Kristala to life. Our developers come from all over the world, united by a shared passion for storytelling, creativity, and the dark fantasy worlds we build together.


We foster a positive, collaborative environment where every team member’s voice matters and we’re excited to welcome another talented developer to join us for this next chapter.


If you’re a technically sharp, team-oriented developer who loves solving challenges and wants to help bring Kristala to players worldwide, we’d love to hear from you!
